select_hub.title: Select an Arlo SmartHub
select_hub.description: Select a discovered SmartHub to populate its local connection details, or enter the details manually.

user.title: Arlo Local owner authentication
user.description: Discovered SmartHub connection details are filled in when available. Check the details or enter them manually, then use the Arlo account that owns the SmartHub. IMAP supports unattended email MFA; push requires approval in the Arlo app. Manual email or SMS MFA requires entering a one-time code. The existing Aarlo account is not changed.

mfa.title: Enter Arlo verification code
mfa.description: Enter the six-digit code sent by Arlo. The code is not saved.

reauth.title: Reauthenticate Arlo Local
reauth.description: Update the owner account or MFA settings. Existing valid local credentials are retained.

progress.authenticate: Authenticating and verifying SmartHub certificates. Approve the Arlo push if requested.

error.invalid_mfa: Enter a valid six-digit verification code.
error.invalid_config: Enter the required hub and authentication settings.
error.cannot_connect: Could not validate the local SmartHub connection.
error.inventory_unavailable: Unable to verify the owner and SmartHub inventory.
error.issuance_unresolved: A prior certificate issuance is unresolved. Existing credentials were retained; no new request was sent.

abort.already_in_progress: A setup flow for this SmartHub is in progress.
abort.invalid_discovery: The discovered service is not a supported SmartHub.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: The selected SmartHub does not match the configured device.

init.title: Local streaming capacity
init.description: Set the maximum number of simultaneous upstream camera connections for this SmartHub. Three is recommended until sustained operation is verified. Reducing the limit does not stop current viewers; new connections are rejected until capacity is available.

prewarm.name: Prewarm camera
prewarm.description: Request a bounded local video-only warm lease for a camera. This does not guarantee that video is ready.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Lease lifetime in seconds. Renew explicitly if needed.

release_prewarm.name: Release camera prewarm
release_prewarm.description: Release the integration-owned warm lease without stopping independent viewers.

local_connection.title: Arlo Local connection unavailable
local_connection.description: The local connection could not be verified. Cached inventory is retained; the integration will retry.

inventory.title: Arlo Local inventory refresh failed
inventory.description: The last successful inventory is retained. Cameras are not removed because of an unsuccessful refresh.

certificate.title: Arlo Local certificate requires attention
certificate.description: A renewal could not be verified. Existing certificate material is retained. Check owner authentication and the issuance state before another request.
